messages:
jamie: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a compact per-route health card for Console that combines p50/p95/p99, RPS, error %, and a tiny token-latency waterfall. Goal: make regressions visible during model/kernel rollouts without opening the full route detail page.

sana: nice. are we also showing kernel attribution? i.e., which kernel choice caused the p99 shift?

omar: +1 on kernel attribution. for Dedicated customers we need to show whether the fallback to cpu/quantized kernel is the culprit.

jamie: yes — plan is to surface an attribution line (kernel=A vs kernel=B) on the p95/p99 sparkline and an enum tag in the card header. card mock: `Route QuickHealth` with a little badge for `kernel` and `kv-hit-rate`.

lexi: question: token-latency waterfall is high-cardinality. how are we sampling? we should avoid per-request full-token traces at 100% RPS.

sana: agree. proposal: sample 1% of requests for full waterfall, 10% for token-slice histograms (p50/p95 per slice). implement an adaptive sampler that increases sampling when p99 rises > 2x baseline.

jamie: that's what I was thinking. also will populate the card with aggregated per-route buckets: short (<64), mid (64-256), long (>256) so the card stays compact.

omar: what about error rate churn during kernel rollouts? we need an error-rate delta panel that shows pre/post rollout windows and flags if error rate increase > 0.5% absolute or 25% relative.

jamie: adding a small alert indicator (yellow/red) based on those thresholds. default window = last 15m vs prior 15m.

lexi: for telemetry — do we depend on existing route metrics or need new ingest fields? we need kernel_id, kv_hit boolean, batching_mode, seq_len_bucket. otherwise attribution won't work.

sana: ack. current ingest has `route`, `latency_ms`, `status_code`, `model_variant`. we need to add `kernel`, `kv_hit`, `batch_size`, `seq_len_bucket` tags. small schema change. i can make an API to append those tags in runtime telemetry.

jamie: can we ship the UI with mock data first and flip runtime once schema lands? people like quick demos.

omar: yes demo-first is good. product acceptance criteria: 1) card present on per-route list 2) p50/p95/p99 calculation matches route detail 3) kernel and kv-hit attribution visible 4) an opt-in sampling toggle per-route

lexi: ops note: sampling toggle must default off for high-traffic routes. add a global sampling budget and per-route cap.

jamie: UX mock pasted below (inline):

```
Route QuickHealth — /chat/infer
[badge] kernel: openai-opt-kv 
[badge] kv-hit-rate: 84% 
RPS: 480  |  errors: 0.8%  |  p50/p95/p99: 18ms / 72ms / 310ms
Token waterfall (sampled):  token1: 6ms | tokenN: 120ms
Trend sparkline (p99) with kernel color bands
```

jamie: Also thinking about an expand action that opens per-route timeline where you can toggle stack attribution: batching vs kv-warmup vs kernel-switch.

omar: make sure we include a small table row for recent rollouts (timestamp, model/kernel, delta-p99, action recommended). that will help SRE/product during canaries.

sana: Implementation notes from telemetry side: I'll add `kernel` and `kv_hit` tags to the runtime emitter this week. we'll send them as low-cardinality enums. seq_len_bucket will be a bucket string (short/mid/long).

lexi: For storage/queries: use reservoir sampling for full token waterfalls and pre-aggregate token-slice histograms into ClickHouse materialized views. keep per-route a 1h retention of full-sampled traces, long-term histograms only.

jamie: Sounds good. Can we also add a small AD hoc query link `View traces` that runs a pre-populated query with the route and time window? saves hunting through the traces page.

omar: +1. Also add an annotation hook so that if a canary rollout happens we automatically mark the timeline with `rollout:<id>` — helpful for correlation.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `telemetry-schema-v2` to staging — started at 2198765520 by sana

jamie: nice — once that's in staging, i'll push the mock UI and wire the demo to staging telemetry. then we can do a demo next THU during eng sync.

lexi: action items: sana: telemetry tags & sampler API; jamie: UI mock + smallcard implementation; omar: acceptance criteria + rollout annotation; me (lexi): query views & reservoir sampling infra.

jamie: timeline: aim for staging demo in 6 days, GA in ~3 weeks assuming no regressions. any blockers?

sana: one potential blocker: runtime tagging needs a tiny change in kernel selection path; should be low risk but needs a runtime patch and a canary.

omar: ok, schedule canary with small traffic and monitor the card during rollout.

jamie: thanks all — i'll create the card PR and drop the mock link once deploy is green. :rocket:
